text: The meeting identified several problems, including a missing display and preparation gaps for the kickoff.
Actions were assigned to the Project Manager to summarize items and to defend the design.
Design work will be advanced by the Industrial Designer with an overview of three design phases and initial conceptual design.

Key decisions established scope and business targets: introduction, pricing at 25 euros with a target of 50 million Euros in sales, phase one functional design, a focus on TV/video with potential for future features, user-friendliness, and a lean feature set.
